summary: Confirmed present, unchanged, on main-debug @ 89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df: HLMatrixBitcastLowerPass.cpp:244 constructs IRBuilder<>(LI) inside the StoreInst arm, where LI is guaranteed null (sibling if/else-if arm). This is an unconditional null deref once the branch executes, per IRBuilder's Instruction* ctor semantics. Several agent-constructed dxc -T lib_6_x -link repro attempts did not trigger it (AlwaysInlinerPass inlines the cross-module call before the buggy pass runs), so the verdict rests on static source verification, not an executed crash of this exact branch. The 2026-04-27 comment's crash is a separate, unrelated bug in HLMatrixLowerPass.cpp (different file/function/fault).
title: Typo and potential null dereference in HLMatrixBitcastLowerPass.cpp
